content: Is Nengazen wey is Pinilì Din he Hadì

content.text: Migkaǥi is Nengazen diyà te Nengazen ku he hadì te,
taman te igkepezizalem ku ziyà te menge paa nu is menge kuntada nu.”
ebpuun te Zion ibpemeluag te Nengazen is ginhedian nu,
ne edhedian nu is menge kuntada nu.
Dutun te andew te kedtebeka nu te menge kuntada nu, andam is menge etew nu te ked-uǥup kenikew.
Is menge vetan-en he menge etew nu edhendiyà te kenikew zutun te segradu he menge vuvungan he henduen be sikandan te menge zehemug emun meselem.
Nenangdù is Nengazen, ne kenà egkahalin is isip din, he memumuhat ka te wazà pidtemanan, iring te kegkememumuhat ni Melkizedek.
Is Nengazen diyà te egkekewanan nu;
edèdeetan din is menge hadì emun ibpeehè din en is pauk din.
Edsilutan din is menge nasyun ne mahabet is ebpenhimetayan din.
Edèdeetan din is ebpemendumala seled te tivuuk he kelibutan.
Sikew, Mahal he Hadì, ed-inum ka ziyà te wahig he edtudà he ziyà te kilid te zalan,
umbe edlikù is desen nu ne ebpekezaag ka.
